title: The Cowboys Don’t Want to Own Other Sports Teams

sources.title: The Cowboys Don’t Want to Own Other Sports Teams
sources.description: The owners of the world’s most valuable—and most profitable—sports team are not interested in expanding their portfolio to include more franchises. “We’re football [only],” Dallas Cowboys co-owner and COO Stephen Jones said on the latest episode of Sportico Sports Business Presented by Endava. “We’ve had those opportunities and we just feel like the Cowboys are …
